terms.definition: A typed semantic result that can be copied only when its type has the closed K0 Copy property, otherwise moved.
A statically identifiable storage location and field or index path whose initialization and borrow state can be checked.
A typed subobject identified by an AllocationId and Path, with a storage duration and initialization state.
A dynamic storage instance created by alloc, assigned a fresh AllocationId, and invalidated only by dealloc.
The unique place or transient evaluation position authorized to move or deallocate a non-Copy value.
A statically bounded permission to access a place or allocation without transferring ownership.
The control-flow interval in which a reference permission is live and its referent remains valid.
An unforgeable nominal identity A binding Allocator<A> and every Own<T,A> created in that allocation domain.
A declared class of externally observable or privileged action; effects are not part of K0 user signatures.
An unforgeable owned permission value introduced in K1, not ambient authority.
One of REJECTED, EXPLICIT_FAILURE, TARGET_FAULT, UNSAFE_PRECONDITION, or EXTERNAL_ASSUMPTION; K0 runtime recovery uses explicit sum values.
A returned value, explicit failure, declared target event, allocation event, deallocation event, or resource diagnostic admitted by the Core semantics.
